project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, heritage sites and landscape destinations do not inflate the place score. features.fullDescription: Small oblong gothic, rubble and slate, baronial bell-tower with saddle-back roof. Dated 1883. Elevated site. In the porch are two old collection ladles, jougs, and Dutch bell dated 1506. Good 18th cent. grave stones.
